tei:div.tei:p: 109) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i nang sgrub rin chen dbang gi rgyal po bzhugs so: 110) na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: o rgyan thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: spros med nang sgrub zab mo ni: skal ldan bu yi don du bstan: rgyun khyer 'di la brtson par bya: sa ma ya: skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa ni: na mo: gdod nas rnam dag rang rig bla ma rjer: dus gsum 'du 'bral med par skyabs su mchi: ma rig bzung 'dzin las snang 'khor 'khyams 'gro: rang byung ye shes rtogs phyir sems bskyed do: lan gsum dang: dngos gzhi ni: āḥ bsam brjod bral ba ka dag che: gdangs snang ma 'gags snying rje'i rtsalaḥ rang byung gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs: dbus su pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: 111)rang byung rgyu yi yi ge hrīḥ yongs gyur 'phro 'dus rang nyid ni: mtsho skyes rdo rje sprul pa'i sku: snang srid zil gnon he ru ka: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang: bhan thod 'dzin cing sku la ni: nang gos zab ber chos gos gsum: gsol zhing theg gsum yongs su rdzogs: zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol stabs bzhugs: dbu la pad+ma mthong grol gsol: gsang yum sbas tshul kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin: 'ja' 'od zer 'khrigs 'od klong bzhugs: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: sngo gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas cang 112)te'u snyan thad dkrol: g.yon pas bhan thod thugs kar 'dzin: dar dang rin chen rus rgyan gsol: zhabs gnyis bzhengs stabs pad zlar bzhugs: lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro ma: ser gsal zhal gcig= phyag g.yas cang= g.yon pas bhan= dar dang rin chen= zhabs gnyis bzhengs= nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma: dmar gsal zhal= phyag g.yas cang= g.yon pas bhan= dar dang rin chen= zhabs gnyis bzhengs= mdun 'khor sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma: dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar:

g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin: zhabs gnyis bzhengs stabs pad zlar bzhugs: rang rang rigs kyi ḍā kis bskor: de ltar lha rnams gsal ba yi: sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul ji bzhin du: dam tshig lha yi gnas gsum du: 'bru gsum dag las 'od 'phros bas: 'og min rnga yab dpal ri nas: rig 'dzin 'dus pa gtso dang 'khor: spyan drangs dam ye dbyer med 113)bstims: spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po laḥ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyiraḥ byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: rin chen pad+ma nyi zla'i gdanaḥ dam ye dbyer med ro gcig bzhugs: ma bcos gnyug ma mtha' bral dbyings: rang zhal mjal bar phyag bgyi'o: snang yul dag par rab 'byams klong: 'dod yon zag med mchod pa 'bul: ka dag klong nas lhun grub shar: dkyil dang 'khor gyi rnal 'byor gsal: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las lnga: yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: thun mong grub pa brgyad brnyes shing: mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: lha sngags ting 'dzin nyams chag kun: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan sngar bshags: rang nyid rigs 'dus thugs ka nas: gser rdor rtse lnga'i lte bar hrīḥ sngags kyis g.yas su 'khor ba yi: 'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis byas: 114)tshur 'dus sngags phreng nyid la thim: rgyal kun gsang ba'i yon tan dbang: ma bcos blo bral chen por bzlas: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: oṃ bam̐ ha ri ra tsa hrīḥya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ ces pa brgya stong khri 'bum dang: bye ba gcig gis 'grub par nges: skabs su tshig bdun ci mang brjodaḥ

phyi la rig 'dzin gral du 'khod: the tshom med do sa ma ya: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: skal med rnams la gu h+ya rgya: dregs pa rnam gsum gnyen gyis shig: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: ḍāk+ki'i rgya: zhes pa rig 'dzin nang sgrub zab mo 'di yang pad+ma thub bstan bzang pos bskul ngor: su kha'i ming gis 'khrul snang mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud las dag par bris pa dge'o// thun mtshams mchod bstod ni: oṃ gu ru bid+yā dha ra sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= sogs: shab+da gu ru sarba pū dza hoḥ hrīḥ skye 'gag 'gyur med bde gshegs yongs 'dus rje: ma lus 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon pad+ma 'byung: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las ma lus dang: dkyil 'khor 115) lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: mchog thun dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol: 'gro kun rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas 'thob par shog: ces pa sprang mo'i rdzun ris so/ 116)
